agenda_setting.definition: The power to decide which topics the public thinks about, exercised through selection and emphasis in coverage.

bc_maternal_age.definition: The age of the woman when her child is born, used as a medical label.
bc_maternal_age.example: Maternal age is a label in the record, not a judgement about the mother.

daily_value.definition: A daily guide for an average adult, used as the yardstick the percentages on a panel are measured against.
daily_value.example: One portion gives me 40 % of the daily value for salt.

pd_legitimate_authority.definition: Authority whose basis can be named and questioned, such as checked knowledge, a defined role or a rule that applies to everybody.
pd_legitimate_authority.example: It was legitimate authority: she showed the standard and said who had signed the rule.

psy_fear.definition: A pressure tactic that raises the cost of a slow decision, so that speed feels like safety.
psy_fear.example: The fear in the message was plain: if you wait, you are the one who pays.

war_bluff.definition: A threat that is made without the means or the intention to carry it out.
war_bluff.example: A threat made without the means to carry it out is a bluff, and it costs nothing to make.
